queries.Core neural recording: We will employ si: Simultaneous dual-site in vivo electrophysiology recordings of anterior cingulate cortex and hippocampal CA1 during contextual fear conditioning, slow-wave sleep, CA1 delta waves, sharp-wave ripples, local field potentials, single-unit spiking, tetrode arrays, manual spike sorting, and peri-ripple activity patterns
queries.Learning paradigm: We will conduct conte: Contextual fear conditioning paradigm in mice with square chamber shock grid, three footshocks, continuous recordings of ACC and CA1 local field potentials and spikes during pre-training sleep, training, post-training sleep, and fear test to study sharp-wave ripple memory consolidation.
queries.Information-flow decoding: To investigat: Generalized linear model decoding of anterior cingulate cortex spiking to predict hippocampal CA1 neuronal firing during sharp-wave ripples, testing information flow from ACC to CA1 across pre-ripple time windows and shuffled controls in memory consolidation.
queries.Causal optogenetic test: To establish ca: optogenetic activation of anterior cingulate cortex using AAV-CaMKII-ChR2 and 25 Hz laser stimulation during sleep to record hippocampal CA1 neuronal response latencies, sublayer-specific firing, and interneuron effects in contextual fear memory consolidation
queries.Sublayer classification: We will classif: Classifying hippocampal CA1 pyramidal neurons into superficial and deep sublayers based on sharp-wave deflection amplitude at maximum ripple power in tetrode local field potentials, using thresholds of greater than 50 microvolts for deep CA1 and less than negative 50 microvolts for superficial CA1 during sharp-wave ripples.
queries.Peri-ripple ACC activity analysis: We wi: Peri-ripple event histogram analysis of anterior cingulate cortex spiking relative to hippocampal CA1 sharp-wave ripple onset during pre-training sleep, identifying pre-ripple, post-ripple activity peaks in ACC neurons in memory consolidation
queries.Task-related neuronal categorization: Ad: Categorizing hippocampal CA1 neurons as task-active or task-inactive by comparing firing rates during contextual fear conditioning training to pre-training baseline using a firing activity index ratio
queries.Cell-type classification: We will classi: Cell-type classification of putative excitatory pyramidal neurons and interneurons in hippocampal CA1 using spike waveform, firing rate, and spike width from in vivo tetrode recordings during sharp-wave ripples
queries.Behavioral performance measurement: We w: Measuring freezing behavior during contextual fear conditioning and contextual fear tests to correlate learning outcomes with hippocampal CA1 and anterior cingulate cortex electrophysiology, sharp-wave ripples, and memory consolidation
queries.Pre- and post-training comparative analy: Pre-training and post-training sleep comparative analysis of anterior cingulate cortex and hippocampal CA1 communication during sharp-wave ripples, relating changes to contextual fear conditioning learning and memory consolidation.
